# splectral

Components for Splectral, the browser platform for watching and acting on
P2P swarms: views and scenarios, each a repository. The platform itself is
in [pear-full-square](https://github.com/pear-full-square) (`splectral-*`);
the components are carried, ready to run, by the projects in
**[haiccing](https://github.com/haiccing)** (start there to see them).

| Component | What it is | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| [base-view-map](https://github.com/splectral/base-view-map) | a map of hosts, nodes and resources, activity drawn live; node, manager and metrics pages | every demo (in [base-package-splectral](https://github.com/haiccing/base-package-splectral)) |
| [base-demo-liveness](https://github.com/splectral/base-demo-liveness) | the scenario "A node goes quiet" | [haiccing/base-demo-liveness](https://github.com/haiccing/base-demo-liveness) |
| [base-demo-other-host](https://github.com/splectral/base-demo-other-host) | the scenario "A node on another host" | [haiccing/base-demo-other-host](https://github.com/haiccing/base-demo-other-host) |

Part of the [SPLectrum](https://splectrum.world) engineering infrastructure.
All components MIT licensed.
